purpose: Controlled classification vocabulary for the DC254 Intelligence Monitor. Classification is an AI-assisted aid; original source wording must be preserved alongside it so every extracted skill or topic can be traced back to its source.

topics.facility: Data-centre facilities and projects: new sites, construction, capacity, operational milestones, expansions, ownership
topics.connectivity: Submarine cables, terrestrial fibre, IXPs, cloud regions, network expansions
topics.workforce: Jobs, technical skills, qualifications, courses, certifications, apprenticeships
topics.policy: Regulation, licensing, energy policy, data protection, tenders, public consultations, skills programmes
topics.market: Investment, market entry, financial results, industry reports without a facility/connectivity/workforce/policy claim

record_types.course: A training programme or course listing
record_types.report: A published report or research document
record_types.announcement: A company/agency announcement or press item

rules: Role categories are assigned from keywords in the ORIGINAL title/description only; the original wording travels with the record.
Country is set from explicit evidence in the source (text or .ke domain), never from query scope alone.
Use UNKNOWN for unavailable fields. Never fabricate.
A record's classification is provisional until a human reviewer sets verification_status.
